Leading brand of power supply manufacturer, FSP announced to release HEXA+ series,which based on HEXA series but with upgrade high-quality and much value-priced. 

## Specifications : 

120mm long lasting fan provides superior cooling with minimal noise. HEXA+ Series also provides PCI-Express graphic card connector(s) and 4 units above SATA cable to take care of your need for storage. Built with quality components and dual +12V outputs, HEXA+ Series ensures stabilityand reliability for your system. Besides, HEXA+ Series also protects your PC by providing complete protection (OCP, OVP, SCP) and multiple safety approvals. 

## Improvement :

Compared with HEXA series, HEXA+ series is with longer length of 24 Pin also 4+4 Pin cable, it’s much convenient for you to assemble. 

## Advantages :

HEXA+ Series dose the job efficiently and reliably, making it a stable power supply unit built to satisfy the demands on users looking for entry-level power or the budget minded system builder.

Fully compatible with 4th generation Intel Core Series processors

FSP's power supply provide 100% Compatible with Haswell CPUs.

Meets 80% Efficiency Optimize your PC functions.

2013 ErP/EuP Ready
